status: Original untested task scores and answer keys; no actual learner attainment or intervention efficacy claim
conventions: Scientific pitch labels identify intended sounds in this answer key; a learner sees an actual staff score, not this answer key. Treble staff bottom line E4; ledger C4 below. Quarter is one beat in simple metre; compound9/8 groups three eighth notes per dotted-quarter beat.

scores.repeat: Repeat the two bars once, second time f; no faster tempo implied.
diagnosticChanges: Omit the natural on F4 in bar2: it changes to F#4 under the key signature.
Replace the final rest in bar1 with a sounding quarter note: sound/silence differs although bar duration stays four beats.
scores.recordingTask: After a partner sounds the original two-bar A and the learner hears/rechecks it, record the same melody on a blank treble staff with its key/metre, then compare the recovered performance. Separate reading probe uses unheard B, not a memorised A.

scores.performanceTask: Perform unheard B from the score, retaining the three-beat bar and quarter rest. Produce a different recoverable three-beat second bar and exchange with a partner.
scores.translationTask: Translate B into a devised pitch-contour/duration representation with an explicit key and back to the staff; the contour must not erase exact pitch or silence needed for recovery.

scores.performanceTask: Maintain three dotted-quarter groups; hear the second group subdivided into three eighths. Contrast with three ungrouped or nine equally accented events without changing the total duration.

scores.grouping: 3+2 for this score, declared rather than asserted universal
scores.performanceTask: Realise the declared3+2 grouping and five quarter-beat bar, then compare a changed2+3 grouping with the same total.
Fit three equal triplet notes within the first quarter beat; retain the other beat/rest durations. Do not stretch the bar to five beats.

youngSourceTask.scope: G1/G2 C1.5 components only; not staff literacy

key.triangle: single equal-pulse tap on a woodblock

youngSourceTask.ownEncoding: Create and encode a different repeat-unit sound pattern containing a silent pulse, give only score+key to a partner and check the sounded recovery. Explain the repeating unit and translate its structure to object/letter form for the existing whole pattern claim.
youngSourceTask.nearMiss: Follow teacher sounds instead of symbols; ignore empty square; give decorative marks with no stable meaning.
youngSourceTask.G3AdditionalDuty: Read and use actual standard quarter/eighth/half/dotted-half note or rest signs in a suitable short3/4/rhythmic task AND devise a nontraditional representation. Do not call an arbitrary icon task standard notation.
